549 Process Videos 550 551 For input videos, we support images lists, local path and url. 552 553 ```python 554 # Messages containing a images list as a video and a text query 555 messages = [ 556 { 557 "role": "user", 558 "content": [ 559 { 560 "type": "video", 561 "video": [ 562 "file:///path/to/frame1.jpg", 563 "file:///path/to/frame2.jpg", 564 "file:///path/to/frame3.jpg", 565 "file:///path/to/frame4.jpg", 566 ], 567 'sample_fps':'1', # sample_fps: frame sampling rate (frames per second), used to determine timestamps for each frame 568 }, 569 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 570 ], 571 } 572 ] 573 574 # Messages containing a local video path and a text query 575 messages = [ 576 { 577 "role": "user", 578 "content": [ 579 { 580 "type": "video", 581 "video": "file:///path/to/video1.mp4", 582 "max_pixels": 360 * 420, 583 "fps": 1.0, 584 }, 585 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 586 ], 587 } 588 ] 589 590 # Messages containing a video url and a text query 591 messages = [ 592 { 593 "role": "user", 594 "content": [ 595 { 596 "type": "video", 597 "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", 598 "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, 599 "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, 600 "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, 601 }, 602 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 603 ], 604 } 605 ] 606 607 ``` 608 609 We recommend setting appropriate values for the `min_pixels` and `max_pixels` parameters based on available GPU memory and the specific application scenario to restrict the resolution of individual frames in the video. 610 611 Alternatively, you can use the `total_pixels` parameter to limit the total number of tokens in the video (it is recommended to set this value below 24576 * 32 * 32 to avoid excessively long input sequences). For more details on parameter usage and processing logic, please refer to the `fetch_video` function in `qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py`. 612 613 ```python 614 from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor 615 from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info 616 617 model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( 618 "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" 619 ) 620 621 processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") 622 623 messages = [ 624 { 625 "role": "user", 626 "content": [ 627 { 628 "type": "video", 629 "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", 630 "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, 631 "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, 632 "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, 633 }, 634 {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, 635 ], 636 } 637 ] 638 639 text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) 640 images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) 641 642 # split the videos and according metadatas 643 if videos is not None: 644 videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos) 645 videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas) 646 else: 647 video_metadatas = None 648 649 # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ 650 # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! 651 inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, video_metadata=video_metadatas, return_tensors="pt", do_resize=False, **video_kwargs) 652 inputs = inputs.to(model.device) 653 654 # Inference: Generation of the output 655 generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) 656 generated_ids_trimmed = [ 657 out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) 658 ] 659 output_text = processor.batch_decode( 660 generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False 661 ) 662 print(output_text) 663 ``` 664 665

668 Video Backends and URL Compatibility 669 670 Currently, `qwen-vl-utils` supports three video decoding backends: `torchvision`, `decord`, and `torchcodec`. While `decord` and `torchcodec` generally offer significantly faster decoding speeds compared to `torchvision`, we recommend using `torchcodec`. This is because `decord` has known issues, such as decoding hangs, and its project is no longer actively maintained. 671 672 - For `decord`, if you are not using Linux, you might not be able to install `decord` from PyPI. In that case, you can use `pip install qwen-vl-utils` which will fall back to using torchvision for video processing. However, you can still [install decord from source](https://github.com/dmlc/decord?tab=readme-ov-file#install-from-source) to get decord used when loading video. 673 674 - To use `torchcodec` as the backend for video decoding, follow the installation instructions provided in the official [torchcodec repository](https://github.com/pytorch/torchcodec/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#installing-torchcodec) and install it manually. Note that `torchcodec` depends on FFmpeg for decoding functionality. 675 676 Video URL compatibility is primarily determined by the version of the third-party library being used. For more details, refer to the table below. If you prefer not to use the default backend, you can switch it by setting `FORCE_QWENVL_VIDEO_READER` to `torchvision`, `decord`, or `torchcodec`. 677 678 | Backend | HTTP | HTTPS | 679 |-------------|------|-------| 680 | torchvision >= 0.19.0 | ✅ | ✅ | 681 | torchvision < 0.19.0 | ❌ | ❌ | 682 | decord | ✅ | ❌ | 683 | torchcodec | ✅ | ✅ | 684 685

739 740 #### Flash-Attention 2 to speed up generation 741 742 First, make sure to install the latest version of Flash Attention 2: 743 744 ```bash 745 pip install -U flash-attn --no-build-isolation 746 ``` 747 748 Also, you should have a hardware that is compatible with Flash-Attention 2. Read more about it in the official documentation of the [flash attention repository](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention). FlashAttention-2 can only be used when a model is loaded in `torch.float16` or `torch.bfloat16`. 749 750 To load and run a model using Flash Attention-2, simply add `attn_implementation="flash_attention_2"` when loading the model as follows: 751 752 ```python 753 import torch 754 from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText 755 756 model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( 757 "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", 758 torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, 759 attn_implementation="flash_attention_2", 760 ) 761 ``` 762 763 #### Processing Long Texts 764 765 The current `config.json` is set for context length up to 256K tokens. 766 To handle extensive inputs exceeding 256K tokens, we utilize [YaRN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071), a technique for enhancing model length extrapolation, ensuring optimal performance on lengthy texts. 767 768 For supported frameworks (currently transformers and vLLM), you could modify `max_position_embeddings` and `rope_scaling` in `config.json` to enable YaRN: 769 770 ``` 771 { 772 "max_position_embeddings": 1000000, 773 ..., 774 "rope_scaling": { 775 "rope_type": "yarn", 776 "mrope_section": [ 777 24, 778 20, 779 20 780 ], 781 "mrope_interleaved": true, 782 "factor": 3.0, 783 "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144 784 }, 785 ... 786 } 787 ``` 788 789 When using vLLM for serving, you can also enable YaRN by adding the additional arguments `--rope-scaling` and `--max-model-len`. 790 791 ``` 792 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":3.0,"original_max_position_embeddings": 262144,"mrope_section":[24,20,20],"mrope_interleaved": true}' --max-model-len 1000000 793 ``` 794 795 > Because Interleaved-MRoPE’s position IDs grow more slowly than vanilla RoPE, use a **smaller scaling factor**. For example, to support 1M context with 256K context length, set factor=2 or 3 — not 4. 796 797 ### Try Qwen3-VL-235B-A22 with API! 798 799 To explore Qwen3-VL-235B-A22, a more fascinating multimodal model, we encourage you to test our cutting-edge API service. Let's start the exciting journey right now! 800 ```python 801 from openai import OpenAI 802 803 # set your DASHSCOPE_API_KEY here 804 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY = "" 805 806 client = OpenAI( 807 api_key=DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, 808 base_url="https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1", 809 ) 810 811 completion = client.chat.completions.create( 812 model="qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct", 813 messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [ 814 {"type": "image_url", 815 "image_url": {"url": "https://dashscope.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/images/dog_and_girl.jpeg"}}, 816 {"type": "text", "text": "这是什么"}, 817 ]}] 818 ) 819 print(completion.model_dump_json()) 820 ``` 821 822 For more usage, please refer to the tutorial at [aliyun](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/qwen-vl-api). 823 824 825 ### Web UI Example 826 827 In this section, we provide instructions for users to build a web-based user interface (UI) demo. This UI demo allows users to interact with a predefined model or application through a web browser. Follow the steps below to get started. 828 829 Install the required dependencies by running the following command: 830 831 ```bash 832 pip install -r requirements_web_demo.txt 833 ``` 834 835 836 Launch a browser-based UI to interact with the model: 837 838 ```bash 839 python web_demo_mm.py -c /your/path/to/qwen3vl/weight 840 ``` 841 842 After running the command, you’ll see a link generated in the terminal similar to this: 843 844 ``` 845 Running on local: http://127.0.0.1:7860/ 846 ``` 847 848 Open the link in your browser to interact with the model — try text, images, or other features. For a quick start, you can also use our pre-built Docker image: 849 850 ``` 851 cd docker && bash run_web_demo.sh -c /your/path/to/qwen3vl/weight --port 8881 852 ``` 853 854 855 856 ## Deployment 857 858 We recommend using vLLM for fast Qwen3-VL deployment and inference. You need to install `vllm>=0.11.0` to enable Qwen3-VL support. You can also use our [official docker image](#-docker). 859 860 Please check [vLLM official documentation](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/multimodal_inputs.html) for more details about online serving and offline inference for multimodal models. 861 862 ### Installation 863 ```bash 864 pip install accelerate 865 pip install qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14 866 # Install the latest version of vLLM 'vllm>=0.11.0' 867 uv pip install -U vllm 868 ``` 869 870 ### Online Serving 871 You can start either a vLLM or SGLang server to serve LLMs efficiently, and then access it using an OpenAI-style API. 872 873 The following launch command is applicable to H100/H200; for more efficient deployment or deployment on other GPUs, please refer to the [vLLM community guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/recipes/en/latest/Qwen/Qwen3-VL.html). 874 875 * vLLM server 876 ```shell 877 # Efficient inference with FP8 checkpoint 878 # Requires NVIDIA H100+ and CUDA 12+ '{"video": {"num_frames": -1}}' \ 885 --host 0.0.0.0 \ 886 --port 22002 887 ``` 888 * SGLang server 889 ``` 890 python -m sglang.launch_server \ 891 --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct \ 892 --host 0.0.0.0 \ 893 --port 22002 \ 894 --tp 4 895 ``` 896 * Image Request Example 897 ```python 898 import time 899 from openai import OpenAI 900 901 client = OpenAI( 902 api_key="EMPTY", 903 base_url="http://127.0.0.1:22002/v1", 904 timeout=3600 905 ) 906 907 messages = [ 908 { 909 "role": "user", 910 "content": [ 911 { 912 "type": "image_url", 913 "image_url": { 914 "url": "https://ofasys-multimodal-wlcb-3-toshanghai.oss-accelerate.aliyuncs.com/wpf272043/keepme/image/receipt.png" 915 } 916 }, 917 { 918 "type": "text", 919 "text": "Read all the text in the image." 920 } 921 ] 922 } 923 ] 924 925 start = time.time() 926 response = client.chat.completions.create( 927 model="Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct-FP8", 928 messages=messages, 929 max_tokens=2048 930 ) 931 print(f"Response costs: {time.time() - start:.2f}s") 932 print(f"Generated text: {response.choices[0].message.content}") 933 ``` 934 * Video Request Example 935 ```python 936 import time 937 from max_tokens=2048, 975 extra_body={"mm_processor_kwargs": {"fps": 2, "do_sample_frames": True}} 976 ) 977 978 print(f"Response costs: {time.time() - start:.2f}s") 979 print(f"Generated text: # Qwen3-VL

💜 Qwen Chat   |   🤗 Hugging Face   |   🤖 ModelScope   |   📑 Blog   |   📚 Cookbooks   |   📑 Paper  
🖥️ Demo   |   💬 WeChat (微信)   |   🫨 Discord   |   📑 API   |   🖥️ PAI-DSW

## Introduction Meet Qwen3-VL — the most powerful vision-language model in the Qwen series to date. This generation delivers comprehensive upgrades across the board: superior text understanding & generation, deeper visual perception & reasoning, extended context length, enhanced spatial and video dynamics comprehension, and stronger agent interaction capabilities. Available in Dense and MoE architectures that scale from edge to cloud, with Instruct and reasoning‑enhanced Thinking editions for flexible, on‑demand deployment. #### Key Enhancements: * **Visual Agent**: Operates PC/mobile GUIs—recognizes elements, understands functions, invokes tools, completes tasks. * **Visual Coding Boost**: Generates Draw.io/HTML/CSS/JS from images/videos. * **Advanced Spatial Perception**: Judges object positions, viewpoints, and occlusions; provides stronger 2D grounding and enables 3D grounding for spatial reasoning and embodied AI. * **Long Context & Video Understanding**: Native 256K context, expandable to 1M; handles books and hours-long video with full recall and second-level indexing. * **Enhanced Multimodal Reasoning**: Excels in STEM/Math—causal analysis and logical, evidence-based answers. * **Upgraded Visual Recognition**: Broader, higher-quality pretraining is able to “recognize everything”—celebrities, anime, products, landmarks, flora/fauna, etc. * **Expanded OCR**: Supports 32 languages (up from 10); robust in low light, blur, and tilt; better with rare/ancient characters and jargon; improved long-document structure parsing. * **Text Understanding on par with pure LLMs**: Seamless text–vision fusion for lossless, unified comprehension. #### Model Architecture Updates:

1. **Interleaved-MRoPE**: Full‑frequency allocation over time, width, and height via robust positional embeddings, enhancing long‑horizon video reasoning. 2. **DeepStack**: Fuses multi‑level ViT features to capture fine‑grained details and sharpen image–text alignment. 3. **Text–Timestamp Alignment:** Moves beyond T‑RoPE to precise, timestamp‑grounded event localization for stronger video temporal modeling. ## News * 2025.11.27: We have released the [**Qwen3-VL paper**](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.21631), which introduces many technical details about Qwen3-VL, and we hope it will be helpful to everyone. * 2025.10.21: We have released the **Qwen3-VL-2B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Thinking)) and **Qwen3-VL-32B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking)). Enjoy it! * 2025.10.15: We have released the **Qwen3-VL-4B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking)) and **Qwen3-VL-8B** ([Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct)/[Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking)). Enjoy it! * 2025.10.4: We have released the [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct) and [Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking). We have also released the FP8 version of the Qwen3-VL models — available in our [HuggingFace collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen3-vl-68d2a7c1b8a8afce4ebd2dbe) and [ModelScope collection](https://modelscope.cn/collections/Qwen3-VL-5c7a94c8cb144b). * 2025.09.23: We have released the [Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct) and [Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking). For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=99f0335c4ad9ff6153e517418d48535ab6d8afef&from=research.latest-advancements-list)! * 2025.04.08: We provide the [code](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-VL/tree/main/qwen-vl-finetune) for fine-tuning Qwen2-VL and Qwen2.5-VL. * 2025.03.25: We have released the [Qwen2.5-VL-32B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct). It is smarter and its responses align more closely with human preferences. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-vl-32b/)! * 2025.02.20: we have released the [Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.13923). Alongside the report, we have also released AWQ-quantized models for Qwen2.5-VL in three different sizes: [3B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-AWQ), [7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ) , and [72B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ) parameters. * 2025.01.28: We have released the [Qwen2.5-VL series](https://huggingface.co/Qwen). For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-vl/)! * 2024.12.25: We have released the [QvQ-72B-Preview](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/QVQ-72B-Preview). QvQ-72B-Preview is an experimental research model, focusing on enhancing visual reasoning capabilities. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qvq-72b-preview/)! * 2024.09.19: The instruction-tuned [Qwen2-VL-72B model](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct) and its quantized version [[AWQ](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ), [GPTQ-Int4](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4), [GPTQ-Int8](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int8)] are now available. We have also released the [Qwen2-VL paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.12191) simultaneously. * 2024.08.30: We have released the [Qwen2-VL series](https://huggingface.co/collections/Qwen/qwen2-vl-66cee7455501d7126940800d). The 2B and 7B models are now available, and the 72B model for open source is coming soon. For more details, please check our [blog](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2-vl/)! ## Performance ### Visual Tasks

### Text-Centric Tasks
## Cookbooks We are preparing [cookbooks](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/tree/main/cookbooks) for many capabilities, including recognition, localization, document parsing, video understanding, key information extraction, and more. Capabilities](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/main/cookbooks/document_parsing.ipynb) | The parsing of documents has reached a higher level, including not only text but also layout position [![Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/main/cookbooks/document_parsing.ipynb) | | [Precise Object Grounding Batch inference ```python # for batch generation, padding_side should be set to left! processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left' # Sample messages for batch inference messages1 = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image1.jpg"}, {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/image2.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "What are the common elements in these pictures?"}, ], } ] messages2 = [ {"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are a helpful assistant."}]}, {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Who are you?"}]}, ] # Combine messages for batch processing messages = [messages1, messages2] # Preparation for inference inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt", padding=True # padding should be set for batch generation! ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Pixel Control via Official Processor Using the official HF processor, we can conveniently control the budget of visual tokens. Since the Qwen3-VL processor separates image and video processing, we can independently configure the pixel budget for each modality. - **For the image processor**: The parameter `size['longest_edge']` originally corresponds to `max_pixels`, which defines the maximum number of pixels allowed for an image (i.e., for an image of height H and width W, H × W must not exceed `max_pixels`; image channels are ignored for simplicity). Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` corresponds to `min_pixels`, specifying the minimum allowable pixel count for an image. - **For the video processor**: The interpretation differs slightly. `size['longest_edge']` represents the maximum total number of pixels across all frames in a video — for a video of shape T×H×W, the product T×H×W must not exceed `size['longest_edge']`. Similarly, `size['shortest_edge']` sets the minimum total pixel budget for the video. ```python processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") # budget for image processor, since the compression ratio is 32 for Qwen3-VL, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single image to 256-1280 (32× spatial compression) processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32} # budget for video processor, we can set the number of visual tokens of a single video to 256-16384 (32× spatial compression + 2× temporal compression) processor.video_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 16384*32*32*2, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32*2} ``` - You can further control the **sample fps** or **sample frames** of video, as shown below. ```python messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # for video input, we can further control the fps or num_frames. \ # defaultly, fps is set to 2 # set fps = 4 inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt", fps=4 ) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # set num_frames = 128 and overwrite the fps to None! # inputs = processor.apply_chat_template( # messages, # tokenize=True, # add_generation_prompt=True, # return_dict=True, # return_tensors="pt", # num_frames=128, # fps=None, # ) # inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
### New `qwen-vl-utils` Usage With the latest `qwen-vl-utils` toolkit (backward compatible with Qwen2.5-VL), you can control pixel constraints per visual input. ```bash pip install qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14 # It's highly recommended to use `[decord]` feature for faster video loading. # pip install qwen-vl-utils[decord] ``` Compared to previous version, the new `qwen-vl-utils` introduces: - "image_patch_size": `14` for Qwen2.5-VL and `16` for Qwen3-VL. Default set to `14`. - "return_video_metadata"(Qwen3-VL only): Due to the new video processor, if True, each video returns as (video_tensor, video_metadata). Default set to `False`. ```python # for Qwen2.5VL, you can simply call images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, return_video_kwargs=True) # For Qwen3VL series, you should call images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) ``` 📌 Note: Since `qwen-vl-utils` already resizes images/videos, pass `do_resize=False` to the processor to avoid duplicate resizing.
Process Images For input images, we support local files, base64, and URLs. ```python # You can directly insert a local file path, a URL, or a base64-encoded image into the position where you want in the text. ## Local file path messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "file:///path/to/your/image.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ## Image URL messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "http://path/to/your/image.jpg"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ## Base64 encoded image messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "data:image;base64,/9j/..."}, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] ``` We provide two methods for fine-grained control over the image size input to the model: - Specify exact dimensions: Directly set resized_height and resized_width. These values will be rounded to the nearest multiple of 32 (32 for Qwen3VL, 28 for Qwen2.5VL). - Define min_pixels and max_pixels: Images will be resized to maintain their aspect ratio within the range of min_pixels and max_pixels ```python from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" ) processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") # resized_height and resized_width messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", "resized_height": 280, "resized_width": 420, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] # min_pixels and max_pixels messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg", "min_pixels": 50176, "max_pixels": 50176, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."}, ], } ] # Preparation for inference with qwen-vl-utils text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) images, videos = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16) # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, do_resize=False, return_tensors="pt") inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Process Videos For input videos, we support images lists, local path and url. ```python # Messages containing a images list as a video and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": [ "file:///path/to/frame1.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame2.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame3.jpg", "file:///path/to/frame4.jpg", ], 'sample_fps':'1', # sample_fps: frame sampling rate (frames per second), used to determine timestamps for each frame }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # Messages containing a local video path and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "file:///path/to/video1.mp4", "max_pixels": 360 * 420, "fps": 1.0, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] # Messages containing a video url and a text query messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] ``` We recommend setting appropriate values for the `min_pixels` and `max_pixels` parameters based on available GPU memory and the specific application scenario to restrict the resolution of individual frames in the video. Alternatively, you can use the `total_pixels` parameter to limit the total number of tokens in the video (it is recommended to set this value below 24576 * 32 * 32 to avoid excessively long input sequences). For more details on parameter usage and processing logic, please refer to the `fetch_video` function in `qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py`. ```python from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText, AutoProcessor from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", dtype="auto", device_map="auto" ) processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct") messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ { "type": "video", "video": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen2-VL/space_woaudio.mp4", "min_pixels": 4 * 32 * 32, "max_pixels": 256 * 32 * 32, "total_pixels": 20480 * 32 * 32, }, {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this video."}, ], } ] text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) images, videos, video_kwargs = process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16, return_video_kwargs=True, return_video_metadata=True) # split the videos and according metadatas if videos is not None: videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos) videos, video_metadatas = list(videos), list(video_metadatas) else: video_metadatas = None # since qwen-vl-utils has resize the images/videos, \ # we should pass do_resize=False to avoid duplicate operation in processor! inputs = processor(text=text, images=images, videos=videos, video_metadata=video_metadatas, return_tensors="pt", do_resize=False, **video_kwargs) inputs = inputs.to(model.device) # Inference: Generation of the output generated_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128) generated_ids_trimmed = [ out_ids[len(in_ids) :] for in_ids, out_ids in zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids) ] output_text = processor.batch_decode( generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False ) print(output_text) ```
Video Backends and URL Compatibility Currently, `qwen-vl-utils` supports three video decoding backends: `torchvision`, `decord`, and `torchcodec`. While `decord` and `torchcodec` generally offer significantly faster decoding speeds compared to `torchvision`, we recommend using `torchcodec`. This is because `decord` has known issues, such as decoding hangs, and its project is no longer actively maintained. - For `decord`, if you are not using Linux, you might not be able to install `decord` from PyPI. In that case, you can use `pip install qwen-vl-utils` which will fall back to using torchvision for video processing. However, you can still [install decord from source](https://github.com/dmlc/decord?tab=readme-ov-file#install-from-source) to get decord used when loading video. - To use `torchcodec` as the backend for video decoding, follow the installation instructions provided in the official [torchcodec repository](https://github.com/pytorch/torchcodec/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#installing-torchcodec) and install it manually. Note that `torchcodec` depends on FFmpeg for decoding functionality. Video URL compatibility is primarily determined by the version of the third-party library being used. For more details, refer to the table below. If you prefer not to use the default backend, you can switch it by setting `FORCE_QWENVL_VIDEO_READER` to `torchvision`, `decord`, or `torchcodec`. | Backend | HTTP | HTTPS | |-------------|------|-------| | torchvision >= 0.19.0 | ✅ | ✅ | | torchvision < 0.19.0 | ❌ | ❌ | | decord | ✅ | ❌ | | torchcodec | ✅ | ✅ |

#### Flash-Attention 2 to speed up generation First, make sure to install the latest version of Flash Attention 2: ```bash pip install -U flash-attn --no-build-isolation ``` Also, you should have a hardware that is compatible with Flash-Attention 2. Read more about it in the official documentation of the [flash attention repository](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention). FlashAttention-2 can only be used when a model is loaded in `torch.float16` or `torch.bfloat16`. To load and run a model using Flash Attention-2, simply add `attn_implementation="flash_attention_2"` when loading the model as follows: ```python import torch from transformers import AutoModelForImageTextToText model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained( "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="flash_attention_2", ) ``` #### Processing Long Texts The current `config.json` is set for context length up to 256K tokens. To handle extensive inputs exceeding 256K tokens, we utilize [YaRN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00071), a technique for enhancing model length extrapolation, ensuring optimal performance on lengthy texts. For supported frameworks (currently transformers and vLLM), you could modify `max_position_embeddings` and `rope_scaling` in `config.json` to enable YaRN: ``` { "max_position_embeddings": 1000000, ..., "rope_scaling": { "rope_type": "yarn", "mrope_section": [ 24, 20, 20 ], "mrope_interleaved": true, "factor": 3.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144 }, ... } ``` When using vLLM for serving, you can also enable YaRN by adding the additional arguments `--rope-scaling` and `--max-model-len`. ``` vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":3.0,"original_max_position_embeddings": 262144,"mrope_section":[24,20,20],"mrope_interleaved": true}' --max-model-len 1000000 ``` > Because Interleaved-MRoPE’s position IDs grow more slowly than vanilla RoPE, use a **smaller scaling factor**. For example, to support 1M context with 256K context length, set factor=2 or 3 — not 4. ### Try Qwen3-VL-235B-A22 with API! 1	# 图像链路：fetch_image 与 smart_resize 像素预算
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 独立实现与 `round_by_factor` / `ceil_by_factor` / `floor_by_factor` 等价的对齐取整函数，并能说清「缩小取 floor、放大取 ceil」背后的方向性设计。
8	2. 逐行读懂 `smart_resize` 的三重约束——宽高被 `factor` 整除、总像素落在 `[min_pixels, max_pixels]` 区间、尽可能保持长宽比——并能手算任意输入的输出尺寸。
9	3. 掌握像素预算与视觉 token 数的换算：`min_pixels = T × 32 × 32` 的含义是「这张图最多（或至少）占 T 个视觉 token」，理解 32 倍空间压缩的来源。
10	4. 会用 `resized_height` / `resized_width` 绕过预算精确直控输出尺寸，并知道这条路径的边界与陷阱。
11	
12	本讲只讲**图像**：从 `fetch_image` 的多来源加载，到 `smart_resize` 的预算算法。视频帧链路（`fetch_video` / `smart_nframes`）留给 u2-l3。
13	
14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	### 2.1 承接 u2-l1：patch、merge 与对齐因子
17	
18	u2-l1 已建立的核心事实，本讲直接使用：
19	
20	- ViT 把图切成边长为 \(p\) 的 patch（Qwen3-VL \(p=16\)），再经 \(2\times2\) 空间合并，1 个视觉 token 覆盖 \(2p \times 2p\) 的像素区域。
21	- 因此 `fetch_image` 内部换算出**对齐因子** \(\text{factor} = 2p\)：Qwen2-VL/2.5-VL 为 28，Qwen3-VL 为 32。
22	- 输出图像的宽高都必须是 factor 的整数倍，视觉 token 数为：
23	
24	\[
25	N_{\text{token}} = \frac{H}{\text{factor}} \times \frac{W}{\text{factor}}
26	\]
27	
28	### 2.2 PIL Image 的宽高顺序陷阱
29	
30	本讲会反复在两种「宽高顺序」之间切换，读源码前必须先建立这个意识：
31	
32	- `PIL.Image.size` 返回 **(宽, 高)**；`image.resize((宽, 高))` 也以宽为先。
33	- `smart_resize(height, width, ...)` 的参数与返回值都是 **(高, 宽)** 顺序（高在前）。
34	
35	`fetch_image` 内部正是做了这次翻译（[vision_process.py:L130](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L130) 解包为 `width, height`，[L140](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L140) 又以 `(resized_width, resized_height)` 传回 resize）。自己写实验代码打印 `img.size` 时务必记住：**第一个数是宽**。
36	
37	### 2.3 为什么需要「像素预算」
38	
39	直接把原图喂给模型有三个问题，`smart_resize` 的三重约束逐一回应：
40	
41	| 问题 | 来源 | smart_resize 的应对 |
42	| --- | --- | --- |
43	| 宽高不是 factor 整数倍，patch 网格切不齐 | ViT 按固定 patch 切图 | 宽高对齐到 factor 的倍数 |
44	| 大图产生海量视觉 token，撑爆上下文 | 上下文长度是稀缺资源 | 总像素 ≤ max_pixels |
45	| 小图 token 太少，细节信息不足 | 视觉表征过于粗糙 | 总像素 ≥ min_pixels |
46	
47	同时，为了让模型看到的画面「形状不变形」，缩放过程尽量等比。**预算以像素为单位定义，但真正的稀缺资源是 token**——这就是为什么预算常写成 `T × 32 × 32` 的形式（见 4.4）。
48	
49	## 3. 本讲源码地图
50	
51	| 文件 | 本讲关注的部分 | 作用 |
52	| --- | --- | --- |
53	| [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py) | L24-L27 常量、L41-L53 取整函数、L56-L81 smart_resize、L84-L90 to_rgb、L93-L141 fetch_image | 本讲全部核心逻辑 |
54	| [README.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md) | L477-L532 图像尺寸控制、L348-L356 processor 侧预算 | 官方文档对 min_pixels / max_pixels / resized_* 的说明 |
55	| [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/\_\_init\_\_.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/__init__.py) | L1-L7 | 包级导出：`fetch_image` 与 `smart_resize` 可直接 `from qwen_vl_utils import` 使用 |
56	
57	注意：包级只导出 5 个函数（[\_\_init\_\_.py:L1-L7](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/__init__.py#L1-L7)）。三个取整函数**不在**其中，实验时需要 `from qwen_vl_utils.vision_process import round_by_factor, ...` 从子模块导入。
58	
59	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
60	
61	### 4.1 fetch_image：四种图像来源的统一加载
62	
63	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
64	
65	`fetch_image` 是「一个视觉元素字典 → 一张尺寸合规的 RGB PIL 图像」的完整流水线，分两段：

# 图像链路：fetch_image 与 smart_resize 像素预算

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 独立实现与 `round_by_factor` / `ceil_by_factor` / `floor_by_factor` 等价的对齐取整函数，并能说清「缩小取 floor、放大取 ceil」背后的方向性设计。
2. 逐行读懂 `smart_resize` 的三重约束——宽高被 `factor` 整除、总像素落在 `[min_pixels, max_pixels]` 区间、尽可能保持长宽比——并能手算任意输入的输出尺寸。
3. 掌握像素预算与视觉 token 数的换算：`min_pixels = T × 32 × 32` 的含义是「这张图最多（或至少）占 T 个视觉 token」，理解 32 倍空间压缩的来源。
4. 会用 `resized_height` / `resized_width` 绕过预算精确直控输出尺寸，并知道这条路径的边界与陷阱。

本讲只讲**图像**：从 `fetch_image` 的多来源加载，到 `smart_resize` 的预算算法。视频帧链路（`fetch_video` / `smart_nframes`）留给 u2-l3。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 承接 u2-l1：patch、merge 与对齐因子

u2-l1 已建立的核心事实，本讲直接使用：

- ViT 把图切成边长为 \(p\) 的 patch（Qwen3-VL \(p=16\)），再经 \(2\times2\) 空间合并，1 个视觉 token 覆盖 \(2p \times 2p\) 的像素区域。
- 因此 `fetch_image` 内部换算出**对齐因子** \(\text{factor} = 2p\)：Qwen2-VL/2.5-VL 为 28，Qwen3-VL 为 32。
- 输出图像的宽高都必须是 factor 的整数倍，视觉 token 数为：

\[
N_{\text{token}} = \frac{H}{\text{factor}} \times \frac{W}{\text{factor}}
\]

### 2.2 PIL Image 的宽高顺序陷阱

本讲会反复在两种「宽高顺序」之间切换，读源码前必须先建立这个意识：

- `PIL.Image.size` 返回 **(宽, 高)**；`image.resize((宽, 高))` 也以宽为先。
- `smart_resize(height, width, ...)` 的参数与返回值都是 **(高, 宽)** 顺序（高在前）。

`fetch_image` 内部正是做了这次翻译（[vision_process.py:L130](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L130) 解包为 `width, height`，[L140](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py#L140) 又以 `(resized_width, resized_height)` 传回 resize）。自己写实验代码打印 `img.size` 时务必记住：**第一个数是宽**。

### 2.3 为什么需要「像素预算」

直接把原图喂给模型有三个问题，`smart_resize` 的三重约束逐一回应：

| 问题 | 来源 | smart_resize 的应对 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宽高不是 factor 整数倍，patch 网格切不齐 | ViT 按固定 patch 切图 | 宽高对齐到 factor 的倍数 |
| 大图产生海量视觉 token，撑爆上下文 | 上下文长度是稀缺资源 | 总像素 ≤ max_pixels |
| 小图 token 太少，细节信息不足 | 视觉表征过于粗糙 | 总像素 ≥ min_pixels |

同时，为了让模型看到的画面「形状不变形」，缩放过程尽量等比。**预算以像素为单位定义，但真正的稀缺资源是 token**——这就是为什么预算常写成 `T × 32 × 32` 的形式（见 4.4）。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲关注的部分 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/vision_process.py) | L24-L27 常量、L41-L53 取整函数、L56-L81 smart_resize、L84-L90 to_rgb、L93-L141 fetch_image | 本讲全部核心逻辑 |
| [README.md](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md) | L477-L532 图像尺寸控制、L348-L356 processor 侧预算 | 官方文档对 min_pixels / max_pixels / resized_* 的说明 |
| [qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/\_\_init\_\_.py](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/__init__.py) | L1-L7 | 包级导出：`fetch_image` 与 `smart_resize` 可直接 `from qwen_vl_utils import` 使用 |

注意：包级只导出 5 个函数（[\_\_init\_\_.py:L1-L7](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/qwen-vl-utils/src/qwen_vl_utils/__init__.py#L1-L7)）。三个取整函数**不在**其中，实验时需要 `from qwen_vl_utils.vision_process import round_by_factor, ...` 从子模块导入。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 fetch_image：四种图像来源的统一加载

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`fetch_image` 是「一个视觉元素字典 → 一张尺寸合规的 RGB PIL 图像」的完整流水线，分两段：

1. **加载段**：把五花八门的图像来源（PIL 对象、本地路径、`file://`、HTTP/HTTPS URL、base64 数据 URL）统一变成一个 PIL Image 对象。
2. **缩放段**：按预算（或直控尺寸）调用 `smart_resize` 并执行 `resize`（缩放段见 4.3 与 4.5，本节专注加载段）。

为什么要支持这么多来源？因为真实业务里图像可能躺在磁盘、对象存储（URL）、前端上传的 base64 里，或是上游算法直接产出的内存对象。统一入口让上层 `process_vision_info` 无需关心来源差异。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
fetch_image(ele, image_patch_size)
  1. 取数据：ele["image"]，旧写法回退到 ele["image_url"]
  2. patch_factor = image_patch_size × SPATIAL_MERGE_SIZE   # 16→32
  3. 按类型加载（先判断 PIL，再按字符串前缀分发）：
       PIL.Image 实例      → 直接使用
       http:// / https://  → requests 流式下载 → BytesIO → Image.open → deepcopy

**4.1 apply_chat_template 两种模式**:

Mode A (tokenize=False): "只渲染，不编码" — returns plain string. The vision placeholders stay as single `<|image_pad|>`/`<|video_pad|>` tokens in text. Use when: (1) need custom preprocessing (qwen-vl-utils already resized images → pass do_resize=False), (2) vLLM/other engines need raw prompt + separate tensors.

Mode B (tokenize=True): "渲染 + 编码 + 视觉预处理" — one-stop: loads images from messages, resizes via image_processor (applying size budget), computes grid, expands `<|image_pad|>` ×N, tokenizes, returns tensors incl. pixel_values/video_grid_thw. With return_dict=True + return_tensors="pt".

Key insight: tokenize=True 时 input_ids 里 `<|image_pad|>` 的个数 = 该图视觉 token 数 = (H'/32)×(W'/32)，其中 H'×W' 是经 image_processor 按预算缩放后的尺寸。所以「预算 → 图像实际尺寸 → token 数 → input_ids 长度」是因果链。这就是 4.2 的伏笔。

add_generation_prompt=True: 在末尾追加 `<|im_start|>assistant\n`，让模型接着助手身份生成。

Evidence from web_demo: same file, two branches use two modes. vllm 分支 tokenize=False（L180）因为张量交给 vLLM 引擎自己编码；hf 分支 tokenize=True（L220）一步到位。

- image: longest_edge ↔ max_pixels (H×W ≤ value), shortest_edge ↔ min_pixels.
- video: longest_edge ↔ T×H×W total max; shortest_edge total min.
- Token conversion: image N_tok = H×W/(32×32); video N_tok = T×H×W/(32×32×2).
- README example: image {longest: 1280*32*32, shortest: 256*32*32} → 单图 256~1280 个视觉 token; video {longest: 16384*32*32*2, shortest: 256*32*32*2} → 单视频 256~16384 token.

- Why LEFT: generation continues from the END of each sequence. Now writing the content. A few technical points I want to explain carefully:

**4.1 apply_chat_template 两种模式**:

Mode A (tokenize=False): "只渲染，不编码" — returns plain string. The vision placeholders stay as single `<|image_pad|>`/`<|video_pad|>` tokens in text. Use when: (1) need custom preprocessing (qwen-vl-utils already resized images → pass do_resize=False), (2) vLLM/other engines need raw prompt + separate tensors.

Mode B (tokenize=True): "渲染 + 编码 + 视觉预处理" — one-stop: loads images from messages, resizes via image_processor (applying size budget), computes grid, expands `<|image_pad|>` ×N, tokenizes, returns tensors incl. pixel_values/video_grid_thw. With return_dict=True + return_tensors="pt".

Key insight: tokenize=True 时 input_ids 里 `<|image_pad|>` 的个数 = 该图视觉 token 数 = (H'/32)×(W'/32)，其中 H'×W' 是经 image_processor 按预算缩放后的尺寸。所以「预算 → 图像实际尺寸 → token 数 → input_ids 长度」是因果链。这就是 4.2 的伏笔。

add_generation_prompt=True: 在末尾追加 `<|im_start|>assistant\n`，让模型接着助手身份生成。

Evidence from web_demo: same file, two branches use two modes. vllm 分支 tokenize=False（L180）因为张量交给 vLLM 引擎自己编码；hf 分支 tokenize=True（L220）一步到位。

**4.2 size 预算**:

- image: longest_edge ↔ max_pixels (H×W ≤ value), shortest_edge ↔ min_pixels.
- video: longest_edge ↔ T×H×W total max; shortest_edge total min.
- Token conversion: image N_tok = H×W/(32×32); video N_tok = T×H×W/(32×32×2).
- README example: image {longest: 1280*32*32, shortest: 256*32*32} → 单图 256~1280 个视觉 token; video {longest: 16384*32*32*2, shortest: 256*32*32*2} → 单视频 256~16384 token.
- Default budgets exist in the checkpoint's preprocessor_config.json (待确认 exact values — better not to state specific default numbers; I can say processor.image_processor.size 默认值来自模型仓库的 preprocessor_config.json，可打印查看。不写具体数值).
- Two layers of knobs table: 元素级（u2-l2, per-image min/max_pixels in messages, only works via qwen-vl-utils）vs processor 级（全局，作用于 tokenize=True 时 image_processor 的内部 resize）。And the do_resize=False interplay: 若 qwen-vl-utils 已缩放，processor 端要 do_resize=False，此时 processor 端 size 预算不再生效（避免二次缩放），预算由 utils 侧控制。
- fps/num_frames 可以直接作为 apply_chat_template 的参数传给视频处理器（README L374-L397）；num_frames 会覆盖 fps（需显式 fps=None）。默认 fps=2。这与 u2-l3 的帧采样公式呼应——processor 内部也有自己的采样逻辑（do_sample_frames 默认 True）。

1. **实践目标**：确认 `tokenize` 两种模式的输出差异。

**练习 1**：不加 `add_generation_prompt=True` 会发生什么？
答案：模板渲染出的串在 user 轮结束后没有 assistant 起始标记，模型可能把输入当作"未完成的对话"继续补 user 内容或直接停住，输出通常不符合"回答问题"的预期。

**练习 2**：为什么官方示例要写 `return_tensors="pt"`？
答案：processor 是多框架设计（还可返回 numpy 等），而下一步 `model.generate(**inputs)` 需要 PyTorch 张量；显式指定避免拿到 list 版本的 token id。

### 4.3 generate 与输出裁剪

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=128)` 是自回归解码循环：每步预测一个 token，直到生成结束符或达到 `max_new_tokens`。**关键坑点**：返回的 `generated_ids` 是"输入 + 新生成"拼接而成的完整序列，直接 `batch_decode` 会把你的问题也打印一遍。所以需要裁剪：只保留每个样本中"超出输入长度"的那一段。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
generated_ids        形状 [batch, L_in + L_new]
        │
        │  对每个样本 i：out_ids[len(in_ids):]
        ▼
generated_ids_trimmed  每个样本只保留 L_new 个新生成 token
        │
        │  processor.batch_decode(..., skip_special_tokens=True)
        ▼
output_text           人类可读的回答文本列表
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[README.md:L186-L193](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L186-L193)：推理与裁剪三连。

- L190-L193：`processor.batch_decode(generated_ids_trimmed, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)`。`skip_special_tokens=True` 去掉 `<|im_end|>` 等结束标记；`clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False` 保留原文空格，对代码类输出尤其重要。

这个逐样本 zip 的写法天然兼容 batch 推理。batch 时要注意两件事，见 [README.md:L288-L333](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L288-L333)：L292-L293 注释明确要求 `processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'`（生成模型必须左填充，否则右侧的 pad token 会被当成"待续写"的内容）；L311 把 `messages` 组成"列表的列表"，L320 在调用时加 `padding=True`。左填充时每个样本的 `len(in_ids)` 恰好都等于 batch 的最大长度，裁剪逻辑依然正确。batch 细节在 u3-l1 展开。

3. 会用 `add_vision_id=True` 为多图/多视频对话自动加上「Picture N: / Video N:」编号，并知道编号文本在提示串里的确切位置。
4. 掌握 batch 推理的两个必备设置——`processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'` 与 `padding=True`——并能解释左填充与输出裁剪 `out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 为什么能配合工作。

u1-l3 已经建立了「apply_chat_template → generate → 裁剪解码」的调用链骨架，并在实践中粗看了一眼两种模式的类型差异；本讲把 processor 这一环拆开细讲，所有实践**只需 processor、不需加载模型权重**，笔记本电脑 CPU 即可完成。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 承接前讲：两条已有结论

- **u1-l3**：`processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt")` 一步返回 `BatchEncoding`，其中除了 `input_ids` / `attention_mask`，还有 `pixel_values`、`image_grid_thw`（视频输入时是 `pixel_values_videos` / `video_grid_thw` 等时间戳张量）。
- **u2-l2**：qwen-vl-utils 在 **messages 元素级** 提供 `min_pixels` / `max_pixels` 预算，图像宽高被对齐到 32 的倍数，视觉 token 数 \( N = \frac{H}{32} \times \frac{W}{32} \)。

本讲要回答的追问是：**transformers 的 processor 内部还有一套预算（`size` 字典），它和 qwen-vl-utils 那套是什么关系？谁在什么时候生效？**

### 2.2 AutoProcessor：三合一的预处理入口

`AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(...)` 加载的不是单一对象，而是三个组件的组合：

| 组件 | 访问方式 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tokenizer | `processor.tokenizer` | 文本 ↔ token id，负责 padding |
| image_processor | `processor.image_processor` | 图像加载、缩放（执行 size 预算）、patch 化，持有 `patch_size` |
| video_processor | `processor.video_processor` | 视频帧采样与缩放（执行视频 size 预算） |

README 明确说明 Qwen3-VL 的 processor **把图像与视频处理拆成了两个独立组件**，因此两种模态可以各配一套预算（[README.md:L339](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L339)）。另外，`processor.image_processor.patch_size` 是 patch 边长的**权威来源**——u2-l1 说过「Qwen3-VL 必须传 `image_patch_size=16`，最佳实践是动态读取」，本讲 4.2.3 会看到 web_demo_mm.py 里那句动态读取的真实出处。

### 2.3 Qwen3-VL 提示串中的特殊 token 速查

以下是 README 官方给出的渲染结果中出现的全部特殊 token（出处见 4.3.3 的 [README.md:L729](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L729)）：

| token | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `<\|im_start\|>` / `<\|im_end\|>` | 对话轮次的开始 / 结束包裹符，后跟 `system` / `user` / `assistant` 角色名 |
| `<\|vision_start\|>` / `<\|vision_end\|>` | 一个视觉输入块的包裹符（图像与视频通用） |
| `<\|image_pad\|>` | 图像占位 token（编码阶段按视觉 token 数展开） |
| `<\|video_pad\|>` | 视频占位 token（同样按视觉 token 数展开） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 apply_chat_template 的两种模式

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`apply_chat_template` 有两种工作模式，区别在于「模板渲染」与「视觉预处理 + 分词编码」是否一步完成：

- **模式 A：一步到位（`tokenize=True`）**。渲染对话模板的同时，processor 自动完成图像/视频加载、按预算缩放、patch 化，并把每个视觉占位符展开成与视觉 token 数一致的 `<|image_pad|>` / `<|video_pad|>`，最终返回 `input_ids` + `pixel_values` 等张量。这是 **transformers 推理的默认路径**。
- **模式 B：渲染与编码分离（`tokenize=False`）**。只做模板渲染，返回**纯字符串**：每个图像位置只留**一个** `<|image_pad|>` 占位符。视觉部分交给外部工具（qwen-vl-utils）处理，再由 `processor(text=..., images=..., videos=..., do_resize=False)` 显式编码。这是 **vLLM / 自定义预处理场景的路径**。

为什么需要模式 B？因为 qwen-vl-utils 已经按元素级预算完成缩放与帧采样（u2-l2 / u2-l3），若让 processor 再 resize 一次，既浪费算力又可能破坏已对齐的尺寸，所以要传 `do_resize=False`；而 vLLM 引擎接收的是「原始 prompt 字符串 + 张量字典」，编码由引擎内部完成（这正是 u3-l2 的主角）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
模式 A（tokenize=True，一步到位）
  messages ──渲染模板──▶ 含 <|image_pad|> 占位的提示串
          ──processor 加载图像并按 size 预算缩放（H',W' 对齐 32）──▶ pixel_values + 网格
          ──把占位符展开为 (H'/32)×(W'/32) 个 <|image_pad|>，分词──▶ input_ids
          ──返回──▶ BatchEncoding{input_ids, attention_mask, pixel_values, image_grid_thw, ...}

模式 B（tokenize=False，渲染/编码分离）
  messages ──渲染模板──▶ 纯字符串 text（每个图像仅 1 个 <|image_pad|>）
          ──qwen_vl_utils.process_vision_info──▶ 已缩放的图像/视频张量 + video_kwargs
          ──processor(text=text, images=..., videos=..., do_resize=False)──▶ 同样的 BatchEncoding
          （或把 text + 张量直接交给 vLLM 引擎）
```

两条路殊途同归，但有一条**因果链**值得背下来：

\[ \text{size 预算} \;\Rightarrow\; \text{缩放后尺寸 } H' \times W' \;\Rightarrow\; \text{视觉 token 数 } \tfrac{H'}{32} \times \tfrac{W'}{32} \;\Rightarrow\; \text{input\_ids 长度} \]

这就是为什么 4.2 的预算实验直接表现为「`input_ids` 变长/变短」。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**模式 A 的标准调用**（[README.md:L177-L183](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L177-L183)）：这段是官方 Quickstart 的预处理调用，`tokenize=True` + `return_dict=True` + `return_tensors="pt"` 三件套，messages 里的图像 URL 由 processor 自行下载。

**模式 B 的标准组合拳**（[README.md:L527-L532](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L527-L532)）：L527 用 `tokenize=False` 拿到字符串，L528 用 `process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=16)` 得到已缩放的图像，L532 把两者交给 `processor(text=..., images=..., videos=..., do_resize=False, return_tensors="pt")` 完成**编码**。注意 L530-L531 的注释与 [README.md:L436](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L436) 的📌提示：**utils 已缩放过，processor 必须 `do_resize=False` 以避免二次缩放**——这句话就是两套预算的「交接协议」。

**两种模式在一个真实工程文件里的分工**（[web_demo_mm.py:L180](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L180) 与 [web_demo_mm.py:L220-L226](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L220-L226)）：

- vLLM 分支的 `_prepare_inputs_for_vllm` 用 `tokenize=False` 只取提示串（L180），因为张量要原样交给 vLLM 引擎；
- HF 分支的 `call_local_model` 用 `tokenize=True` 一步拿到全部输入张量直接 `model.generate`（L220-L226，u1-l4 已讲过该分支的流式线程）。

同一个函数族、同一个 messages，两种模式的选择完全由**后端吃什么样的输入**决定——这是本讲最重要的工程直觉。

**`add_generation_prompt=True` 渲染出了什么**：对照 [README.md:L729](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L729) 给出的预期串，末尾是 `<|im_start|>assistant\n`——即「助手轮的开头」。模型从这里续写回答，`batch_decode(skip_special_tokens=True)` 时最终又把它过滤掉。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲眼确认两种模式的输出形态，并数出 `<|image_pad|>` 的个数与其决定因素。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码，只需 processor）：

```python
# 示例代码：u3_l1_practice_a.py
from transformers import AutoProcessor

ckpt = "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct"
processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(ckpt)

messages = [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
        {"type": "image", "image": "https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen-VL/assets/demo.jpeg"},
        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."},
    ],
}]

# 模式 B：只渲染
text = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
print(repr(text))                      # 观察 <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|> 的个数
print("字符串中 image_pad 个数:", text.count("<|image_pad|>"))

# 模式 A：一步到位
inputs = processor.apply_chat_template(
    messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True,
    return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt",
)
print(inputs.keys())
print("input_ids 形状:", inputs["input_ids"].shape)

pid = processor.tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|image_pad|>")
n_pad = (inputs["input_ids"] == pid).sum().item()
grid = inputs["image_grid_thw"][0]     # (t, h, w)
print("input_ids 中 image_pad 个数:", n_pad)
print("image_grid_thw:", grid.tolist(), "乘积:", grid.prod().item())
```

3. **需要观察的现象**：字符串里每个图像只有 **1 个** `<|image_pad|>`；而 `input_ids` 里它是成片出现的，个数恰好等于 `image_grid_thw` 的三元素乘积 \( t \times h \times w \)（图像 \( t=1 \)，即 \( \frac{H'}{32} \times \frac{W'}{32} \)）。
4. **预期结果**：`n_pad == grid.prod().item()` 成立；把 `inputs["input_ids"]` 用 `processor.tokenizer.decode` 解码后与 `text` 逐字符对齐（唯一差异是占位符个数）。具体的 token 数取决于 demo.jpeg 在默认预算下的缩放结果，**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：模式 B 里，如果把 `do_resize=False` 忘了传，会发生什么？
答案：processor 的 image_processor 会对 utils 已缩放好的图像**再执行一次** size 预算缩放。轻则浪费算力，重则当 processor 预算与 utils 预算不一致时图像被二次缩放，`image_grid_thw` 与 utils 意图不符（官方在 [README.md:L436](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L436) 专门加了📌提示）。

**练习 2**：为什么 vLLM 分支用 `tokenize=False` 而不是 `tokenize=True` 后再把张量拆出来？
答案：vLLM 的输入协议是「prompt 字符串 + `multi_modal_data` 张量字典 + `mm_processor_kwargs`」（见 [web_demo_mm.py:L194-L198](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L194-L198)），编码由引擎内部的 processor 完成；自己先编码反而会丢失「按引擎侧预算展开占位符」的机会。

**练习 3**：`add_generation_prompt=True` 渲染出的最后一个 token 是什么？为什么 `batch_decode` 看不到它？
答案：`<|im_start|>assistant\n` 对应的 token；`batch_decode(..., skip_special_tokens=True)` 会过滤特殊 token，所以最终输出文本里不出现。

### 4.2 size 预算参数：image_processor 与 video_processor 的分治

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

processor 级预算写在两个 `size` 字典里，**图像与视频语义不同**是本节最大的坑：

- `processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": ..., "shortest_edge": ...}`
  - `longest_edge` 对应 `max_pixels`：**单张图**的 \( H \times W \) 上限；
  - `shortest_edge` 对应 `min_pixels`：单张图像素下限（[README.md:L341-L342](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L341-L342)）。
- `processor.video_processor.size = {"longest_edge": ..., "shortest_edge": ...}`
  - `longest_edge` 是**全部帧的像素总和**上限：视频形状为 \( T \times H \times W \) 时，\( T \times H \times W \) 不得超过它；`shortest_edge` 是总预算下限（[README.md:L345-L346](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L345-L346)）。

它与 u2-l2 元素级预算构成**两层旋钮**：

| 层次 | 写在哪 | 作用域 | 生效路径 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 元素级 `min_pixels` / `max_pixels` / `total_pixels` | messages 的 image/video 元素里 | 单个输入 | qwen-vl-utils（模式 B） |
| processor 级 `size` 字典 | `processor.image_processor.size` 等 | 该 processor 处理的所有输入 | processor 内部（模式 A，或模式 B 未关 resize 时） |

两层不要同时「较劲」：走模式 B 时预算交给 utils、processor 关掉 resize；走模式 A 时统一由 `size` 说了算。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

图像（32× 空间压缩）：

\[
N_{\text{img}} = \frac{H' \times W'}{32 \times 32}, \qquad
\text{shortest\_edge} \le H' \times W' \le \text{longest\_edge}
\]

视频（32× 空间 + 2× 时间压缩，u2-l3 讲过帧数取偶正源于此）：

\[
N_{\text{vid}} = \frac{T' \times H' \times W'}{32 \times 32 \times 2}
= \frac{T'}{2} \times \frac{H'}{32} \times \frac{W'}{32}, \qquad
\text{shortest\_edge} \le T' \times H' \times W' \le \text{longest\_edge}
\]

反过来，**按目标 token 数配置预算**就用乘法（这就是官方示例数字的由来）：

\[
\text{image size} = N_{\text{img}} \times 32 \times 32, \qquad
\text{video size} = N_{\text{vid}} \times 32 \times 32 \times 2
\]

操作流程：

```text
1. AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(ckpt)
2. processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": N_max*32*32, "shortest_edge": N_min*32*32}
   processor.video_processor.size = {"longest_edge": N_max*32*32*2, "shortest_edge": N_min*32*32*2}
3. （可选）apply_chat_template(..., fps=...) 或 (..., num_frames=..., fps=None) 控制视频采样
4. 之后所有 tokenize=True 的调用都按新预算执行
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**官方预算配置代码**（[README.md:L349-L356](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L349-L356)）：L352 给 image_processor 设 `{"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32}`——L351 注释点破换算：32 倍压缩下，这等于**单张图 256～1280 个视觉 token**；L355 给 video_processor 设 `{"longest_edge": 16384*32*32*2, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32*2}`——L354 注释说明是「32× 空间 + 2× 时间压缩」，即**单视频 256～16384 个 token**。注意赋值是**整体替换** size 字典，两个键都要写全。

**视频采样参数直传 processor**（[README.md:L358-L397](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L358-L397)）：L374-L375 注释说明默认 `fps=2`；L378-L385 示范在 `apply_chat_template` 调用里直接传 `fps=4`；L388-L397 示范 `num_frames=128` 并**同时显式传 `fps=None`** 覆盖之（帧数采样公式本身在 u2-l3 的 `smart_nframes` 已拆解，processor 内部是同一套逻辑的 processor 侧入口）。这组参数只在模式 A / processor 路径下生效；模式 B 的采样由 utils 的 `video_kwargs`（`do_sample_frames=False`）接管。

**patch_size 的权威来源**（[web_demo_mm.py:L181-L186](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L181-L186)）：`process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=processor.image_processor.patch_size, ...)`——不硬编码 16，而是从当前 processor 动态读取。这样 demo 代码对 Qwen2.5-VL（patch 14）与 Qwen3-VL（patch 16）都天然正确，u2-l1 说的「最佳实践」在仓库里的落地就是这一行。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：验证「size 预算 → input_ids 长度」的因果链，并把结果写成笔记。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码；选一张**高分辨率**图片，太小的图会一直贴着下限、看不出差异）：

```python
# 示例代码：u3_l1_practice_b.py
from transformers import AutoProcessor

ckpt = "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct"
processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(ckpt)
print("默认 image size:", processor.image_processor.size)   # 先看默认预算

messages = [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
        {"type": "image", "image": "/path/to/huge_photo.jpg"},   # 换成本地大图
        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe this image."},
    ],
}]

def probe(tag):
    inputs = processor.apply_chat_template(
        messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True,
        return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt")
    L = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
    t, h, w = inputs["image_grid_thw"][0].tolist()
    print(f"[{tag}] input_ids 长度={L}, grid=({t},{h},{w}), 视觉 token={t*h*w}")
    return L

L_default = probe("默认预算")

processor.image_processor.size = {"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32}
L_custom = probe("1280/256 token 预算")

with open("notes.md", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(f"| 默认 | {L_default} |\n| 1280/256 | {L_custom} |\n")
```

3. **需要观察的现象**：两次调用的 `input_ids` 长度差应约等于两次视觉 token 数之差（文本部分不变）；`h × w × 1024`（即像素数）落在 `[256*32*32, 1280*32*32]` 区间内。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 video_processor 的预算数字要额外乘 2？
答案：视频在时间维还有 2× 压缩（相邻两帧合并，u2-l3 的 `FRAME_FACTOR=2`），1 个视频 token 平均消耗 \( 32 \times 32 \times 2 \) 个像素，所以按目标 token 数反推 size 时要乘 2（[README.md:L354-L355](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L354-L355)）。

**练习 2**：把 `processor.image_processor.size` 设成 `{"longest_edge": 256*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32}`（上下限相等）意味着什么？
答案：锁定单张图恰好 256 个视觉 token（u2-l2 讲过因取整方向实际可能略低）——评测或对齐实验中「固定视觉 token 数」的常用手法，代价是长宽比不同的图会被不同程度地拉伸或裁剪策略处理。

**练习 3**：同一个脚本里先走模式 A（processor resize），又给元素加了 `max_pixels`，两个预算谁生效？
答案：元素级 `max_pixels` 是 qwen-vl-utils 的参数，模式 A 根本不经过 utils，所以 processor 的 `size` 生效；元素级预算只在模式 B（`process_vision_info`）里被读取。两层旋钮各管各的路径。

### 4.3 add_vision_id：多模态输入自动编号

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

默认渲染下，图像/视频内容是「裸」地嵌进对话的。多图多轮对话中，用户说「第二张图里的狗」，模型只能靠位置隐式推断「第二张」是哪个。`add_vision_id=True` 让模板在每个视觉块前自动插入一段**普通文本编号**（`Picture N: ` / `Video N: `），把隐式的位置信息显式化——用户与模型从此有了一个共同的指代锚点。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

编号规则（由官方示例的预期输出可直接读出）：

- 图像序列独立编号：`Picture 1`、`Picture 2`、`Picture 3`……跨轮次**持续累加**，不因新开一轮而重新计数；
- 视频序列独立编号：`Video 1`、`Video 2`……与图像计数互不干扰；
- 编号文本插在 `<|vision_start|>` **之前**、属于提示串的普通文本 token（不是特殊 token）。

```text
content: [text, image, image, video, text]
默认:    text <vis_start><image_pad><vis_end> <vis_start><image_pad><vis_end> <vis_start><video_pad><vis_end> text
加编号:  text Picture 1: <vis_start>... Picture 2: <vis_start>... Video 1: <vis_start>... text
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**功能说明**（[README.md:L690-L691](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L690-L691)）：官方定位——默认图像与视频内容直接嵌入对话，处理多图时加标签便于指代，行为由用户开关控制。

**示例对话**（[README.md:L696-L723](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L696-L723)）：五轮对话含 1 图（首轮）+ 第二个 user 轮里 2 图 1 视频混排，是观察「跨轮累加」与「图/视频独立计数」的最佳样本。注意该示例的 `{"type": "image"}` 元素**不带图像数据**，因此它展示的是模板渲染层面的结果——自己复现时要显式传 `tokenize=False` 拿字符串（带真实图像时可继续 `tokenize=True`）。

**两种渲染的预期输出对照**（[README.md:L725-L729](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L725-L729) 默认 vs [README.md:L732-L736](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L732-L736) `add_vision_id=True`）：L736 的串里可以看到 `Picture 1: <|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>`、`Picture 2: ... Picture 3: ... Video 1: <|vision_start|><|video_pad|><|vision_end|>`——首个 user 轮的图是 Picture 1，第二个 user 轮的两张图接着是 Picture 2、3，视频单独从 Video 1 起数。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲手渲染出与 README 预期一致的编号串。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码；无图像数据也能跑，与官方示例同构）：

```python
# 示例代码：u3_l1_practice_c.py
from transformers import AutoProcessor

processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct")
conversation = [
    {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "image"},
                                  {"type": "text", "text": "Hello, how are you?"}]},
    {"role": "assistant", "content": "I'm doing well, thank you."},
    {"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "text", "text": "Describe these images and video?"},
        {"type": "image"}, {"type": "image"}, {"type": "video"},
        {"type": "text", "text": "These are from my vacation."}]},
]

s_default = processor.apply_chat_template(
    conversation, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
s_with_id = processor.apply_chat_template(
    conversation, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, add_vision_id=True)
print(s_default)
print("=" * 40)
print(s_with_id)
```

3. **需要观察的现象**：`s_default` 里三个视觉块前没有任何文字标签；`s_with_id` 里依次出现 `Picture 1:`、`Picture 2:`、`Picture 3:`、`Video 1:`，且都位于 `<|vision_start|>` 之前。
4. **预期结果**：与 [README.md:L736](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L736) 的预期串结构一致（assistant 回复内容因 messages 简写而略有出入属正常）。**待本地验证**。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`Picture N` 的 N 会不会因为换了一轮对话而重新从 1 开始？
答案：不会。README 示例中第一个 user 轮的图是 `Picture 1`，隔了一个 assistant 轮之后，第二个 user 轮的图接着编号 `Picture 2`、`Picture 3`——编号沿**整段对话**累加。

**练习 2**：`add_vision_id` 加进来的「Picture 1:」会被 `skip_special_tokens=True` 过滤掉吗？
答案：不会。它是普通文本 token，不是特殊 token；而 `<|vision_start|>` 等会被过滤。

**练习 3**：既然编号只是普通文本，为什么不手工在 text 元素里写「第一张图：」达到同样效果？
答案：可以，且效果等价——`add_vision_id` 的价值在于**自动**保证编号与视觉元素的实际顺序一致、免维护；手工编号在插入/删除图像时容易漏改错位。

### 4.4 batch 推理与左填充

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

batch 推理把多条样本的 `input_ids` 叠成一个矩形张量 \([B, L_{\max}]\)，但各样本长度天然不同，必须补齐（padding）。**关键约定：生成式模型必须左填充**——新生成 token 是接在每条序列**末尾**续写的，若把 pad 补在右侧，pad 会插在「提示结束」与「新生成」之间，模型把无意义的 pad 当成待续写内容；补在左侧则所有样本的真实内容都在序列右端对齐，`generate` 从同一位置起续写。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
两条样本（长度 12 与 35，pad_token 记为 PAD）
右填充（错误示范）:  [c₁..c₁₂  PAD PAD ... PAD]   ← 新 token 会生成在 PAD 之后
左填充（正确）:      [PAD PAD ... PAD c₁..c₁₂]   ← 真实内容右端对齐
                     [c₂₁ ... c₂₃₅            ]

attention_mask 与 input_ids 同形：pad 位置为 0，真实 token 为 1（左填充 ⇒ 每行 0 集中在开头）
裁剪依然成立: generated_ids[i] 的前 L_max 个是输入（含 pad），
             out_ids[len(in_ids):] 依旧正确裁掉整个输入前缀
```

注意一个容易忽略的事实：**batch 里可以混合多模态样本与纯文本样本**——视觉张量沿 batch 维独立拼接，文本侧的 padding 完全不干扰 `pixel_values` / `image_grid_thw`。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**左填充的两行设置**（[README.md:L292-L293](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L292-L293)）：L292 注释直言「batch generation 必须 left」，L293 `processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'`——注意改的是 **tokenizer** 的属性（padding 由 tokenizer 执行，见 [web_demo_mm.py:L228](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/web_demo_mm.py#L228) 中 processor 持有 tokenizer 的三合一结构）。

**混合模态 batch 的样本构造**（[README.md:L296-L311](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L296-L311)）：`messages1` 含两张图，`messages2` 是带 system 轮的**纯文本**对话；L311 `messages = [messages1, messages2]` 组成「列表的列表」——外层是 batch 维，内层才是一条对话。

**调用时的 `padding=True`**（[README.md:L314-L321](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L314-L321)）：L320 在 `apply_chat_template` 里显式传 `padding=True`（L320 行内注释：batch generation 必须设置）。**设了 `padding_side` 却忘传 `padding=True`（或反之）都会让 batch 失效**，两者是一对。

**裁剪与解码对 batch 的兼容**（[README.md:L325-L332](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L325-L332)）：与单样本完全同款的 `zip(inputs.input_ids, generated_ids)` + `out_ids[len(in_ids):]`——左填充下每条 `len(in_ids)` 都等于 \( L_{\max} \)，逐样本裁剪天然正确，无需任何改动。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：观察左填充在张量上的真实形态，验证裁剪逻辑不受 padding 影响。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码；最后一步生成可选，只看张量可跳过加载模型）：

```python
# 示例代码：u3_l1_practice_d.py
from transformers import AutoProcessor

processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct")
processor.tokenizer.padding_side = "left"          # 设置一：方向

messages1 = [{"role": "user", "content": [
    {"type": "image", "image": "/path/to/a.jpg"},
    {"type": "text", "text": "What is in this picture?"}]}]
messages2 = [{"role": "user", "content": [
    {"type": "text", "text": "Who are you?"}]}]

inputs = processor.apply_chat_template(
    [messages1, messages2],                        # 外层 = batch 维
    tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True,
    return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt",
    padding=True,                                  # 设置二：开关（与设置一成对）
)
print("input_ids:", inputs["input_ids"].shape)
print("attention_mask 每行前 8 个:", inputs["attention_mask"][:, :8])
print("每行 padding 个数:", (inputs["attention_mask"] == 0).sum(dim=1).tolist())
pad_id = processor.tokenizer.pad_token_id
print("pad_token:", processor.tokenizer.pad_token, "开头是否为 pad:",
      (inputs["input_ids"][:, 0] == pad_id).tolist())
```

3. **需要观察的现象**：`attention_mask` 的 0 **全部集中在每行开头**；较短样本（纯文本那条）所在行的 0 更多；`input_ids` 每行长度相同（等于 batch 内最长序列）。
4. **预期结果**：若再加载模型执行 `model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=32)` 并用 `out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 裁剪，两条输出都应是干净的新生成文本、不含 pad 与提示词。具体 pad 数量取决于两条样本的长度差，**待本地验证**。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：只用 `padding=True` 而不改 `padding_side`，最可能看到什么现象？
答案：tokenizer 默认右填充，pad 补在序列右侧。生成会把 pad 当成提示的一部分续写下去，输出常以无意义内容开头，甚至永不命中结束符；同时「真实提示右端对齐」被破坏。

**练习 2**：左填充后，`inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]` 对两条样本分别意味着什么？
答案：都等于 batch 内最长序列的长度 \( L_{\max} \)——含 pad。因此逐样本 `len(in_ids)` 相同，`out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 恰好裁掉「pad + 提示」的完整输入前缀。

**练习 3**：batch 中一条含 2 张图、一条纯文本，`pixel_values` 会为纯文本样本补空张量吗？
答案：不会。视觉张量只按实际存在的图像拼接（`image_grid_thw` 逐图记录网格），文本侧 padding 与视觉侧互不相干——[README.md:L296-L311](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L296-L311) 的官方 batch 示例正是这种混合模态组合。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：写一个 `processor_probe.py` 体检脚本，产出一份《processor 行为笔记》。** 把本讲四个模块串成一个可复跑的脚本，对**同一组 messages**（1 张高分辨率图片 + 1 段提问）依次完成：

1. **渲染检查**（4.1）：`tokenize=False` 打印提示串，人工标注 `<|im_start|>` / `<|vision_start|>` / `<|image_pad|>` / `<|im_end|>` 各出现几次。
2. **展开验证**（4.1 + 4.2）：`tokenize=True` 下统计 `input_ids` 中 `<|image_pad|>` 的个数，与 `image_grid_thw` 三元素乘积对照，再验证乘积 × 1024（像素数）落在当前预算区间内。
3. **预算对照**（4.2）：分别在「默认预算」与 `{"longest_edge": 1280*32*32, "shortest_edge": 256*32*32}` 两档下记录 `input_ids` 长度与视觉 token 数，写进 `notes.md` 的表格，并用一句话解释长度差来源。
4. **编号对照**（4.3）：把 messages 扩成「2 图 + 1 视频占位」的多轮对话，`add_vision_id` 两种取值各渲染一次，把 diff 行摘进笔记。
5. **batch 检查**（4.4）：把（多模态样本，纯文本样本）组成 batch，`padding_side='left'` + `padding=True`，记录 `input_ids` 形状与每行 padding 数。

**验收标准**：`notes.md` 中应能回答——这张图在你的默认预算下占多少视觉 token？改预算后 `input_ids` 长度变化了多少、差值是否恰等于视觉 token 数之差？左填充的 0 在张量的哪一侧？全部结论都来自你自己的运行输出（本环境无 GPU/未装 transformers，结果**待本地验证**）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `apply_chat_template` 有两种模式：`tokenize=True` 一步返回含 `pixel_values` / `image_grid_thw` 的张量（transformers 路径）；`tokenize=False` 只返回字符串、每个图像仅 1 个 `<|image_pad|>` 占位（配合 qwen-vl-utils + `do_resize=False`，或交给 vLLM）。web_demo_mm.py 的两个后端分支就是两种模式的活样本。

- processor 级预算分治：`image_processor.size` 的 longest/shortest_edge 约束**单图** \( H \times W \)；`video_processor.size` 约束**全帧总和** \( T \times H \times W \)；按目标 token 数配置时分别乘 \( 32 \times 32 \) 与 \( 32 \times 32 \times 2 \)。

- batch 推理两件套缺一不可：`processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'` + `padding=True`；左填充让真实内容右端对齐，pad 位置 `attention_mask=0`，逐样本 `out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 裁剪无需任何修改，且 batch 可混排多模态与纯文本样本。

2. 掌握 `processor.image_processor.size` 与 `processor.video_processor.size` 两套像素预算的**语义差异**（单帧预算 vs 全帧总预算），能按目标视觉 token 数反推出 size 取值，并说清它与 u2-l2 元素级预算的分层关系。
3. 会用 `add_vision_id=True` 为多图/多视频对话自动加上「Picture N: / Video N:」编号，并知道编号文本在提示串里的确切位置。
4. 掌握 batch 推理的两个必备设置——`processor.tokenizer.padding_side = 'left'` 与 `padding=True`——并能解释左填充与输出裁剪 `out_ids[len(in_ids):]` 为什么能配合工作。

u1-l3 已经建立了「apply_chat_template → generate → 裁剪解码」的调用链骨架，并在实践中粗看了一眼两种模式的类型差异；本讲把 processor 这一环拆开细讲，所有实践**只需 processor、不需加载模型权重**，笔记本电脑 CPU 即可完成。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 承接前讲：两条已有结论

- **u1-l3**：`processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt")` 一步返回 `BatchEncoding`，其中除了 `input_ids` / `attention_mask`，还有 `pixel_values`、`image_grid_thw`（视频输入时是 `pixel_values_videos` / `video_grid_thw` 等时间戳张量）。
- **u2-l2**：qwen-vl-utils 在 **messages 元素级** 提供 `min_pixels` / `max_pixels` 预算，图像宽高被对齐到 32 的倍数，视觉 token 数 \( N = \frac{H}{32} \times \frac{W}{32} \)。

本讲要回答的追问是：**transformers 的 processor 内部还有一套预算（`size` 字典），它和 qwen-vl-utils 那套是什么关系？谁在什么时候生效？**

### 2.2 AutoProcessor：三合一的预处理入口

`AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(...)` 加载的不是单一对象，而是三个组件的组合：

| 组件 | 访问方式 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tokenizer | `processor.tokenizer` | 文本 ↔ token id，负责 padding |
| image_processor | `processor.image_processor` | 图像加载、缩放（执行 size 预算）、patch 化，持有 `patch_size` |
| video_processor | `processor.video_processor` | 视频帧采样与缩放（执行视频 size 预算） |

README 明确说明 Qwen3-VL 的 processor **把图像与视频处理拆成了两个独立组件**，因此两种模态可以各配一套预算（[README.md:L339](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L339)）。另外，`processor.image_processor.patch_size` 是 patch 边长的**权威来源**——u2-l1 说过「Qwen3-VL 必须传 `image_patch_size=16`，最佳实践是动态读取」，本讲 4.2.3 会看到 web_demo_mm.py 里那句动态读取的真实出处。

### 2.3 Qwen3-VL 提示串中的特殊 token 速查

以下是 README 官方给出的渲染结果中出现的全部特殊 token（出处见 4.3.3 的 [README.md:L729](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-VL/blob/96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da/README.md#L729)）：

| token | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `<\|im_start\|>` / `<\|im_end\|>` | 对话轮次的开始 / 结束包裹符，后跟 `system` / `user` / `assistant` 角色名 |
| `<\|vision_start\|>` / `<\|vision_end\|>` | 一个视觉输入块的包裹符（图像与视频通用） |
| `<\|image_pad\|>` | 图像占位 token（编码阶段按视觉 token 数展开） |
| `<\|video_pad\|>` | 视频占位 token（同样按视觉 token 数展开） |
